name: Nach Innen Prolouge
source:
In this short kinetic novel, we get introduced to She, a mysterious woman who sets off to find out what happened to her one beautiful hometown, that one day was suddenly destroyed by something unknown.

We also get introduced to the real main character of Nach Innen, Aimi.
